name: 1pcs Soft Silicone Toothbrush for Baby
description:
1pcs Soft Silicone Toothbrush for Baby 

Color: Yellow, Green, Pink(Mix Color Randomly, you can not specify the color) 
Material: Food-grade Silicone 
Develops good oral hygiene early, preventing cavities later. 
Food Grade silicone material, very durable. 
Easy for baby to hold, while preventing choking. 
Bendable soft silicone reduces risk of injury, providing the safest learning experience possible. 
Helps to soothe sore teething gums with durable massaging bristles. 
made in china
